title: Publication requests, approval and immutable receipts
summary: SocialPublicationRequest carries versioned CMS context; independent publication authority and SocialLibrary policy precede provider execution. Duplicate requests return their existing receipt if the fingerprint matches.
invariants: Idempotency identity is scoped to the full publication fingerprint; a reused request ID with altered payload must fail.
The same CMS content revision may be rendered in channel-specific variants only with explicit provenance and approval references.
A recorded dispatch intent is not proof that the remote content was published.
The simulated provider cannot claim live delivery.
